PAKISTAN COUNCIL OF SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH MEDICAL
ATTENDANCE REGULATIONS, 2014
PAKISTAN COUNCIL OF
SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH MEDICAL ATTENDANCE REGULATIONS, 2014
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II, 10th January, 2015]
S.R.O. 13(I)/2015, dated 8-1-2015.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 19 of Pakistan Council of
Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973 (XXX of 1973), the Pakistan
Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, with the previous sanction of
the Federal Government, is pleased to make the following regulations, namely:--
1. Short
title, commencement and application.---(1) These regulations may be called
the Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Medical Attendance
Regulations, 2014.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
(3) These
shall apply to all the employees and their families and the Chairman and
members of the Governing Body.
2. Definition.---In
these regulations, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or
context,
(a) "act"
means Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973 (XXX of
1973);
(b) "authorized
officer" means Director-General or Director or Principal or Officer in
Charge of the Institute and Secretary PCSIR in case of Head Office;
(c) "council"
means the Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research;
(d) "doctor"
means a medical practitioner registered with Pakistan Medical and Dental
Council (PMDC) and includes a specialist of any particular disease or field;
(e) "employee"
means a regular employee of the Council and includes a retired employee,
provided that he/she is not employed elsewhere or is not availing medical
facility from any other source and also includes family;
(f) "family"
means dependent parents, husband or wife or wives, legitimate children and step
children, sisters and minor brothers residing with and wholly dependent upon
the employee:
EXPLANATION
(I).---Wife of an employee shall be deemed to be wholly dependent upon him
so long as she is not judicially separated or divorced;
EXPLANATION
(II).---Son and step-son of an employee shall be deemed to be wholly
dependent upon him till they attained the age of eighteen years and shall
thereafter be deemed to be so dependent only if he certifies that they are
residing with him and are wholly dependent upon him;
EXPLANATION
(III).---Sister, daughter and step-daughter of an employee shall
be deemed to
be wholly dependent
upon him till they are married and thereafter shall
normally be assumed to have ceased to be so dependent unless he certifies that
they are wholly dependent upon him;
EXPLANATION
(IV).---Mentally retarded children declared as such by the doctor would be
deemed to be wholly dependent upon the employee;
EXPLANATION
(V).---The expression 'residing with' shall not be so construed as to
exclude any member of the family of an employee other than his parents, wholly
dependent upon such employee but actually not residing with him for example the
son or daughter of an employee studying at a place other than his headquarters
or the wife of employee temporarily away from such headquarters;
(g) "hospital"
means a Hospital which is registered with the Council as Hospital for the
purpose of these regulations and includes nursing homes, clinics, laboratories
etc., registered as such;
(h) "medical
attendance or treatment" means any medical attendance or treatment in a
Hospital or at the residence of the employee and includes,
(i) such
pathological, bacteriological, radiological or other methods of examination for
the purpose of diagnosis as are available in the Hospital and are considered
necessary by the doctor;
(ii) use
of all medical and surgical facilities available at the Hospital in which an
employee is treated;
(iii) transfusion
of blood, as are considered necessary by the doctor and Hospitals etc., but
excluding the cost of blood;
(iv) supply
of such medicines, vaccines, sera or other therapeutic substances as are
